name: design-gate
description: Checks a built UI against its design mock (Figma, image, PDF, HTML or claude.ai artifact) in every aspect: missing screens, sections, controls and features, content, states, layout and visual tokens. Also gates changes for AI design slop, with the mock and design tokens as the allow-list. Writes gap checklists that Sonnet subagents can work through cold, then re-checks each gap.
